landquest.title: LandQuest
landquest.description: A GPS + NFC treasure-hunt app for real land. Play a demo hunt — follow riddles across a moonlit map, home in with the radar, and uncover the property's secrets.

dome-generator.title: Dome & Zome Generator
dome-generator.description: Design geodesic domes, zomes, hybrids, and pyramids in live 3D — material lists, cut lists with bevel angles, CSV and OBJ export.

trillium-plans.title: Trillium Plans Studio
trillium-plans.description: Sixteen dome and zome plans as one interactive studio — explode the 3D model panel by panel, read the cut schedules, and see the audit that cross-checks every printed dimension.

wikihouse-configurator.description: Interactive 3D configurator for a WikiHouse Skylark 250 cabin — arrange modules, preview the build, and export the block list.

mask-generator.description: Design a wearable CNC mask from your face measurements — AI-generated carving, stacked/egg-crate/rotary outputs, real cut files.

wall-panel-generator.title: Wall Panel Generator
wall-panel-generator.description: Design a 3D-printed wall panel of hundreds of pieces — swirling blades, organic cells, radial rings — plan art across a zome's panels, start from 26 ready-made designs, then export the print kit: Bambu Studio files with every piece numbered, a mounting frame or CNC backer, and a 1:1 assembly map.

extras.title: 3D Modeling Portfolio
extras.description: Fusion 360 designs and functional prints, viewable and spinnable right in the browser.
